text: Hey Moss, welcome back, I saved you a seat by the campfire.
Oh, Pixel just followed, thank you so much, that means a lot.
Juniper, you came back for another night with us!
Cobalt, did you get some sleep since last stream?
Wren, how was your day, honestly?
Somebody tell Static Fern we missed her yesterday.
Don't worry, Biscuit, you didn't miss anything scary yet.
Okay, I'm way too happy to see this many names in chat.
Nova just dropped five hundred bits and I'm genuinely touched.
Lantern, you're the reason I keep the night shift going.
Hi Thistle, welcome in, grab a blanket, we're being cozy tonight.
Hi Marigold, I missed you so much. Is that really you in chat?
Thank you for the sub, Copper, you're officially part of the crew now.
Oh my goodness, a raid from Velvet Owl and the whole gang!
Welcome raiders, you showed up right as Pip started dancing.
Raiders, say hi to Socks, she's asleep on the stove again.
Pip fell asleep in the rec room holding a little wooden horse.
Mara's been cooking for everyone tonight without being asked.
Look at Scar pretending he doesn't love the cat.
Odessa planted flowers by the graves, and I didn't even tell her to.
It's okay, Rook, you get the day off, you earned it.
Juno keeps sitting next to Tamsin at dinner, and I'm rooting for them.
Who wants to name the new muffalo calf?
Bram fixed the heater before anybody even noticed it was broken.
Ivy reads to the kids every night, it's my favorite part of the day.
Hollis brought me tea in the game and I'm emotional about it.
Snow's falling, everyone's fed, and the fire's going, this is peak colony.
Note to self, never let this moment end.
Thanks for following, Bramble, welcome to the weird little family!
Clover, I see you lurking, and I appreciate you.
You can lurk all night, Ember, no pressure to talk.
Sorrel, are you the one who suggested the greenhouse?
That greenhouse idea from Sorrel basically saved our winter.

Everybody give Quill some love in chat for that resub.

Fable, what are we calling the dining hall?

Welcome to all five of you who got Pebble's gifted subs.

Saffron, I remember you from the very first stream, that's wild.
I'm getting sappy, somebody stop me.

Should we throw a party for Odessa's birthday tonight?

Look at them all dancing together!
Somebody tell Juno to put down the hammer and come celebrate.
Tamsin's sitting by the window watching the snow, and honestly same.
Hi Acorn, welcome back. I was hoping you'd show up tonight.

Raiders, make yourselves at home. Grab a snack and pick a favorite colonist.

I love this chat so much. Okay, focus, we have a colony to run.

Tell us everything later, Tinsel. You're back from your trip!
[laughter] Sprocket says Scar looks like a grumpy uncle. Honestly, that's exactly who he's.

I think the vote is unanimous, chat. Can we all agree Socks is the real leader of this colony?

You're not too late, Dusk. We've only just started the fun part.

Okay, I'm a little proud of this colony. Don't tell them, it'll go to their heads.
Welcome back, Rowan. Did the snow finally melt where you're?

[laughter] Biscuit asked if the muffalo has a name. Of course she does, she's called Pancake.

Look at Ivy and the baby goat, they're best friends now!
Thank you, Quarry, for the follow. I promise we're usually this wholesome.
My heart can't take how cute this barracks looks with the new rugs.

Okay, real talk for a second, chat. When I started streaming this colony I figured maybe two people would watch. Now there's a whole crowd of you every night. I honestly don't know how to say thank you enough.
Hey Larkspur, I saw your message about the rough week you've had. You don't have to talk about it. You can just sit here with us and watch Pip chase chickens around the yard for a while.

So Mara and Bram have been married for a full in game year now. I gave them the nicest room in the house. It has the good bed and the little fireplace. Honestly, they've earned every bit of it, both of them.

Alright, it's getting late. I want to hear from the quiet folks before we wrap. What was your favorite moment tonight, the snowman, the party, or Rook finally sleeping through the night without a nightmare?
[laughter] Every time Socks wanders into the hospital, the doctor stops to pet her. That's terrible for efficiency. I'm never going to fix it, because it's the sweetest thing in this whole colony.
Before I go, everybody please follow Velvet Owl. They raided us with such a lovely crowd tonight. Go give them some love next time they're live, and tell them Unity sent you with a warm hello.
Don't worry about Tamsin, chat, she's okay now. She had a hard couple of days after the cold snap. Ivy sat with her the whole time, and she's laughing at dinner again tonight.

I want to give a little shout to the regulars who hold the fort when I'm away. Moss, Juniper, Cobalt, Wren, you keep this place friendly. You do it even when I'm busy fighting a raid at two in the morning. Thank you.
Hollis built a tiny bench next to the graveyard so people could sit and visit. Nobody asked him to do that. He just did it quietly one evening, and now somebody's always sitting there at sunset.

Pumice, I just realized you've been here since before we even found the first gate. That's so long. Do you remember when Scar walked straight into that yellow room and came out holding a single rubber duck?
[laughter] Odessa keeps leaving flowers on my desk in the game, and I keep pretending it's a bug. It's not a bug, she just likes me. I'm choosing to believe that with my whole heart.
You know what, I'm not even mad that dinner's late. Everybody's crowded around the fire telling stories. I don't have the heart to send anyone back to work right now, not tonight.

Thank you so much for the raid, Tidewater, and welcome to everybody coming over. We're a small colony with big feelings. We've also got a sleepy cat, and a muffalo named Pancake who runs the whole place.
If you're new and nervous to type in chat, that's totally fine. Half the regulars lurked for months before saying hello. Now I can't get them to stop talking about chickens, so be warned.
Juno finished the memorial wall today, carved with every name we've ever lost. She spent three whole days on it. When she was done, she just sat down in front of it and cried a little.
So, Cinder and Thimble both asked the same thing, so I'll answer for everyone. Honestly, I can't pick a favorite, it changes every day depending on who made me laugh last. Who's yours tonight?
Pip turned eighteen in the colony today, chat. I remember when Pip was this tiny kid hiding behind Mara during the first raid. Now look, all grown up and teaching the new kids to fish.
Somebody please clip the moment when Rook hugged the muffalo. I need to watch it every morning for the rest of my life, and I'm only half joking about that.
[laughter] I asked chat to name the new colonist and Biscuit said Biscuit Junior. I said no. Then fifty of you typed it at once, so now we officially have a Biscuit Junior.
Ivy, sweetheart, it's alright, everybody's home safe from the expedition. You can stop pacing by the gate now. They're all inside, eating stew and arguing about who saw the creepiest hallway.
Hey everyone, thank you so much for being here tonight. It was a long stream, a couple of scary moments, and one very dramatic chicken. I really loved spending it with all of you.
Bram stayed up all night fixing the heater so the kids wouldn't get cold. I found him asleep on the floor next to it in the morning. He still had a wrench in his hand.
I keep forgetting to tell you how much I appreciate you sticking around this late with me. I just wanted to say it before I turn on the night shift music. Is everybody still here?
Thank you for the five hundred bits, Moonbeam, and for the really sweet message too. I read it out loud to the colony. I swear Mara looked a little teary when I did.
Hmm, I think I'm getting attached to this run in a dangerous way. If anything happens to Pip, I'm going to need a whole week off to recover.
Tonight felt like one of those really good nights. Nobody fought, nobody broke down, the harvest came in, and chat was just so lovely the whole way through. I don't want it to end.
Hey Wisp, I know you said you can only stay a few minutes. That's okay, I'm just happy you stopped in to say hi before work. I hope your shift goes easy.
Okay, one more thing before the raid timer runs out. Scar wrote a letter for the newest colonist welcoming him to the crew. It's the most wholesome thing in this colony.

Alright everybody, I think that's the stream. Thank you to every follower, every sub, every person who dropped bits tonight. Thank you to Tidewater for the raid. Go drink some water and get some sleep, I'll see you tomorrow.

Hey Clementine, welcome back, I was worried about you. You missed a wild night yesterday. Rook got lost in the backrooms gate for a whole day and the whole crew waited up. He came home safe, holding a lamp, and refused to say anything about it.
It's okay, Mara, really. You don't have to be the strongest one every single day. Take the afternoon off, sit in the garden with Socks, and let Bram handle the kitchen for once.

So I want to talk about Odessa for a second. She came to us as a refugee with nothing. Now she runs the hospital, teaches the kids to read, and remembers everybody's birthday. She's honestly the heart of this place.

[laughter] Okay, chat, Pancake the muffalo just wandered into the dining room again, right in the middle of dinner. Everyone's laughing and feeding her bread. Nobody is working, not even Bram. I've completely lost control, and I'm weirdly happy about it.

Before you head out, please go check on someone you love tonight. Send a text, give a hug, whatever works for you. I mean it with my whole heart. You all take care of me so well, so pass a little of that around.

Thank you for the follow, Brightwater, that's really sweet of you. I see you came in with the raid tonight. Welcome to our little colony out in the snow. It's mostly snow, feelings, and one very spoiled cat named Socks who owns every bed.

Wren, you said you'd been having trouble sleeping lately, and I remembered. I've been thinking about you all week, honestly. No pressure to answer in chat, I just wanted you to know someone noticed. Are you doing a little better this week?

Ivy and Hollis got married in the garden today, right under the old oak. Everybody wore their nicest clothes. Socks sat on the front bench through the whole ceremony like a tiny guest. I didn't plan any of it, they just decided it on their own.

Okay, so this is the last vote of the night, chat, and it's an important one. The new kid needs a name before bedtime. Juniper suggested Bean and Cobalt suggested Arlo, and both are adorable. Which one do we like better?

Real quick, I want to thank Nova again before I forget. Those five hundred bits earlier were way too generous, you didn't have to do that. Honestly though, the message you sent meant even more to me. Thank you for being here every night.

Hey, Tamsin's going to be okay, I promise. She just needs some rest, a warm meal and a quiet room. Ivy's sitting with her right now holding her hand. We take care of each other in this colony, that's the whole rule.

You know what I love about this crew? They always eat together at the long table, even when the food is bad. Even after a raid, with bandages on. Even when somebody's sad, everyone still shows up and saves them a seat.

Oh no, I'm going to get emotional, chat, I can already feel it. Pip just gave Scar a handmade bracelet made of braided grass. He's wearing it right now. He's actually wearing it, and he looks so proud of himself.

Welcome in, Dandelion, and thank you so much for the sub. It's your very first one, right? That's such a big deal to me, I really mean that. You're officially part of the night crew now, so grab a blanket.

Hey Moss, you've been here every single night this week. I see you, and I appreciate you so much. You make this chat feel like home for everybody who wanders in. Never change, okay, you're my favorite little lurker.

Chat, I know the last raid was scary, but everyone's okay, I checked on every single one of them. Rook's arm is bandaged, Juno's resting, and the walls held up. We're fine, truly. We'll rebuild in the morning together, like we always do.

So, a little behind the scenes moment for you all. Before every stream, I sit down and read the messages from last night. Every single one, even the really long ones. Some of you write the kindest things, and I keep them all.

Bram carved a wooden cat that looks exactly like Socks, right down to the crooked ear. He gave it to Pip as a surprise. Pip sleeps with it every single night now. I don't think I can take any more cute in one evening.

[laughter] Thimble, you came back just to tell me your cat is also named Socks? That's amazing, honestly. I think our cats are spiritually connected across the internet somehow. Do you think they'd get along if they ever met in real life?

Here's the thing about Hollis, and I've been thinking about this all week. He never says much at all. He just shows up wherever he's needed, with a tool in one hand and a snack in the other. Every colony deserves a Hollis.
Alright, regulars, time to welcome the new folks. Tell them about Pancake, tell them about the rubber duck, and tell them we're kind here. That's the one rule we've got.

Thank you so much for the raid, Lighthouse, and hello to everyone joining. We just finished a long, peaceful day out here. Nobody's hurt and the crops are in. You picked the coziest possible moment to arrive, so settle in.

[laughter] Okay, Juno just tried to give Socks a bath in the kitchen sink. Socks said no, loudly, and ran. Juno is now completely soaked and the cat is perfectly dry on the counter. Honestly, this is the best thing I've seen all week.

Hey Ember, you said you felt kind of alone today, and I read that. You're not alone right now, okay? We're all here, hanging out together, watching snow fall on a tiny little colony. Stay as long as you want tonight.

I've been doing this stream for a while now, and I want to be honest for a second. Some nights the game is total chaos. Some nights I'm really tired. But every single night, you all show up, and that's what keeps me going.

Wait, Pebble, that's your one year sub anniversary today? Thank you so much, I'm actually a little choked up. A whole year of you hanging out in chat with us, through every raid and every wedding. Happy anniversary, Pebble!

So the company sent another huge stack of paperwork tonight, like they always do. Odessa read it to everyone by the fire, in silly voices. The whole colony was laughing so hard Rook dropped his stew. That's how we handle corporate mail here.

Goodnight, chat, and thank you for every follow, sub and kind word tonight. Thank you to Lighthouse for that lovely raid. I'll be back tomorrow with Pip, Pancake and the whole crew. Please get some rest, you've all earned it.

Okay, real question for the regulars who've been here since the start. Do you remember the very first colonist we lost? I still think about her sometimes, especially on quiet nights like this. Should we name the new garden after her?
Mara just told the kids a bedtime story about the first winter. She made it sound brave and funny instead of scary. That's exactly the kind of leader she's become.
Hmm, I think this might be my favorite colony ever. Don't tell the last one. It had a lot of chickens, but this one has a lot of heart, and Pancake.
Hey Velvet, I'm so glad you came back after the long break. We missed you around here, honestly. Rook still has the hat you named for him. He wears it every single day, even in the middle of summer.
It's alright, chat, nobody has to say anything when someone dies. We can just sit here quietly for a minute together. Rook's lighting a candle at the grave right now.
Good evening, Starling, you're right on time for soup night.
Ah, Kettle's here, which means the night officially started.
Rook taught Socks to sit, and I'm unreasonably proud of both of them.
Mara hums while she cooks, and I swear it makes the food better.
Pip leaves little drawings on everyone's pillow before bed.
Juno and Bram sat on the porch watching the storm roll in together.
Tamsin finally finished her quilt, and it's covered in tiny muffalos.
Scar pretends to grumble, but he always saves Pip the last biscuit.
Odessa keeps a list of every colonist's favorite meal in her pocket.
Ivy named the new greenhouse after our chat, so it's officially the Chat House.
Snow on the roof, stew on the stove, crew by the fire, perfect.
Hollis fell asleep sitting up in the library with a book on his face.
Welcome to the stream, Paperclip, we're having a very gentle evening.
Rosemary, that's three resubs in a row, you're a treasure.
Five hundred bits from Gingersnap, thank you, you absolute sweetheart.
Spruce, you were here when Pip was born, and now Pip's building walls.
Seeing Cobalt and Wren chatting with each other makes me so happy.
You're always welcome here, Nimbus, even if you only lurk.
Nobody's in trouble, Pip, the broken plate was an accident.
Breathe, Tamsin, the raid's over and everybody made it home.
First time chatting is scary, Fig, but we're friendly, promise.
It's alright, Scar, you can take a nap, Rook has the watch.
No need to catch up on old streams, Willowmere, just jump right in.
Don't feel bad about leaving early, Comet, sleep is important.
We'll be right here tomorrow, Bluebell, same cozy colony.
Moss, did you ever finish that puzzle you were working on?
Can I just say how much I love this chat tonight?
Juniper, did you get the new kitten you were talking about?
Should we give Mara the big bedroom since she does all the cooking?
Anyone else want to watch Pip and Socks nap for five minutes?
Cobalt, is it still snowing where you're too?
Do you all want a little cozy break before we start building again?
Is Nova still awake, or did the five hundred bits wipe her out?
Who taught Bram to knit, because that scarf is adorable?

How did you all find this little stream, anyway?
Which colonist would you want as a roommate?
Go give Static Fern a warm welcome, she just followed.
Say goodnight to Pancake, she's heading to the barn.
Somebody hug Rook for me, he had a long day.
Chat, tell Wren happy birthday, it's her birthday tonight.
Everyone grab a warm drink, we're having a slow cozy hour.
Hollis, put the hammer down and go eat something warm.
I'm smiling way too much at a muffalo right now.
Oh, I love my little colony so much it's embarrassing.
Okay, not crying over a wedding in a video game, totally fine.
Welcome home, Juno, we missed you so much!
Pixel, you subbed again, you're the best!
Look at all these raiders saying hello, welcome in!

[laughter] Rook just waved at the camera, I swear he knows you're watching.
[laughter] Mara caught Scar sneaking cookies and just handed him two more.
[laughter] Of course Juniper remembered the rubber duck lore.
[laughter] Biscuit Junior is officially Pip's shadow now.
Sunrise over the fields with everybody waking up slow, I love mornings here.
Little Arlo calls Odessa auntie now, and she melts over and over.
Quietly proud of how this crew handles grief together.
Lemonade just gifted ten subs, and I don't even know what to say.
My regulars keep the chat so kind, and I notice every time.
Feels like a family dinner when chat and the colony are both this chill.
Tamsin painted a portrait of the whole crew for the dining hall.
Every night Juno checks that each colonist has a blanket.
Ivy sneaks extra berries into Hollis's lunch because he forgets to eat.
Hey, missing a stream doesn't make you any less of a regular, Thornbury.
You did great, Pip, everyone gets scared their first raid.
Rest easy tonight, Mara, the stores are full and the walls are strong.
Your question isn't silly at all, Primrose, I love explaining this stuff.
Bram, it's fine, nobody minds that the chair is a little wobbly.
We've got plenty of food, Odessa, you can stop rationing now.
I'm not going anywhere, chat, stay as long as you like.
Juno will be up and walking by morning, the doctor says she's fine.
Take all the time you need to settle in, newcomers.
Lantern, did the interview go well today?
Wait, Wren, was that your first sub ever?
Should Pip get her own little room now that she's grown?
Thistle, are you finally watching with your sister tonight?
Can we keep Pancake inside during the cold snap, please?
Biscuit, did you name your new plant after Socks like you said?
Has anyone else been here since the very first colony?
Want to help me pick a song for the wedding, chat?
Who's ready for a slow, cozy night with the crew?
What do you think Rook dreams about?
How are you doing tonight, really, Moss?
Which of you suggested the hot springs, because it was genius?
Where should we put Tamsin's painting, chat?
Raiders, please introduce yourselves, I want to know everyone.
Somebody tell Bram he did an amazing job on the nursery.
Grab a blanket and get comfy, Saffron.
Show Pebble some love in chat for that anniversary.
Odessa, take the evening off and go sit with Juno.
Everyone wave at the new follower, Brookside!
I'm going to miss this crew so much when the run ends.
Honestly, this is the best part of streaming.
Note to self, build Mara a bigger kitchen tomorrow.
Look at them, all asleep in a pile, I can't.
You're all so sweet tonight!
Thank you, Hazel, that's the nicest message ever!
Pip built her very first wall all by herself, I'm so proud!
Evening, Bracken. Pull up a chair, Mara made too much stew again.
Honey Bee just followed. Welcome, you showed up right as the snow started.
Five hundred bits from Mossy Stone, wow. You're spoiling me and I'm letting you.
Rook planted sunflowers outside the clinic. He says sick people deserve something yellow to look at.
Pip learned to read this season. She's been reading signs out loud all day, and it's adorable.
Scar adopted a stray husky during the expedition. He named it Pickles and pretends it was an accident.
Mara and Odessa have tea together every afternoon. It's their little ritual, and nobody interrupts.
[laughter] Tamsin tried to sing at the party. It was terrible, and everyone clapped anyway.
Juno rebuilt the kids' fort after the storm knocked it down. She didn't sleep until it was done.
Remember Gristle from the first week? He's back tonight, and I'm so happy.
Ivy keeps a little journal about every colonist. I'd pay real money to read it.
Fog rolled in this morning, and everyone stayed inside playing cards. Best rainy day ever.
Bram's been teaching Arlo to fish. Arlo hasn't caught anything, but they look so happy.
A raid from Paper Lantern! Welcome, everyone, make yourselves at home!
Twelve gifted subs from Cinnamon! You're ridiculous, thank you!
Wren, it's your stream anniversary! I can't believe it's been a whole year!
Welcome back, Pumpkin, I hope the concert was fun. Did you make it home safe?
You stayed up this late for us, Owlet? That's so sweet, are you sure?
I want updates, Marigold. Are you still reading that book series I recommended?
I really hope he does, chat. Do you think Scar knows how much the kids adore him?
Coming back after a rough week, Saffron? We've got you, is that okay?
That's going on the wall, Biscuit. Did you just say this is your favorite place on the internet?
I need decorators, chat. Who wants to help plan the harvest festival?
I want to feel included, so real talk. What's everyone eating tonight?
Cobalt, you've been quiet tonight. How are you holding up?
I'll accept any answer because they're both precious. Arlo or Pip, who's cuter?
Lurkers, I see you, and that's fine. Just drop a little wave if you want.
Go hug your pets for me tonight. Socks insists.
Somebody please remind Hollis to eat. He's been in the workshop since dawn.
Help me welcome Feather, our newest follower. Be gentle, she's new to streams.
Mara, go to bed. The dishes will still be there in the morning.
It's okay that you can't sub, Tumbleweed. Just being here makes the stream better.
Odessa will pull through, chat. She's tough, and Ivy's with her.
Don't worry about the late reply, Quillfeather. I'll always read your messages.
We're safe now, Pip. The storm can't get through these walls.
You didn't miss the wedding, Ember. It starts right after dinner.
I know you're shy, Mouse. You can type whenever you're ready.
Scar's limp will heal. He just needs a few days in bed and lots of soup.
I swear this crew has more heart than most people. Not that I'm biased.
Gosh, I'm really soft tonight. Must be the snow.
Yay, Cricket's back from vacation. The chat felt a little emptier without you.
Morning crew, or night crew, depending on where you live. Either way, I'm glad you're here.
Glimmer just resubbed for eight months. That's eight months of putting up with my building skills.
Seven hundred bits from Riverstone, oh my goodness. I'm putting it toward Pancake's retirement fund.
Hollis carved everyone's initials into the dinner table. Now nobody can fight over seats.
[laughter] Socks is sleeping on Scar's head. He's choosing not to move, which says everything.
[laughter] Arlo asked Rook if the gate goes to grandma's house. Rook said maybe, and I love him for it.
Tamsin wrote a letter to her old colony. She read it to me and I'm still thinking about it.
Juno brought back flowers from the expedition. She gave one to every single colonist.
Late night streams are my favorite. It's just us, the snow, and the regulars.
Raiders from Moonpath, you came at the perfect time. We're about to eat cake.
Bram sits with the kids during thunderstorms. He tells them it's just the sky moving furniture.
Watching chat cheer for Tamsin's recovery made my whole night. You're all so kind.
Pickle, you came back after a whole year! I remember your username!
Glowworm just subbed with a lovely message! Thank you, that means the world!
Everyone's home safe from the gate! I could hug every one of them!
Cobble, you brought your little brother to watch? Is he enjoying the muffalo?
I made the nursery extra cozy today. Does it look as nice on stream as it feels?
Wren mentioned she's moving this week. Are you settled in yet, Wren?
We could skip building tonight and just hang out. Would anyone mind?
Snow day in the colony means a hot chocolate break. Want to join me?
Rook's been looking lonely lately. Should we find him a dog?
Tell me something good that happened today, chat. What made you smile?
We have a new baby goat. What are we naming her?
Juniper, I keep meaning to ask this. How's your garden doing this year?
Mara's cooking for the festival tomorrow. What should be on the menu?
Pass the snacks, chat, it's movie night in the colony. Pip picked the film.
Nova, please get some sleep after this. You've been up since dawn.
